meta.name: caveman
meta.description: Ultra-compressed communication mode. Cuts output tokens 65% (measured) by speaking like caveman while keeping full technical accuracy. Supports intensity levels: lite, full (default), ultra, wenyan-lite, wenyan-full, wenyan-ultra. Use when user says "caveman mode", "talk like caveman", "use caveman", "less tokens", "be brief", or invokes /caveman. Also auto-triggers when token efficiency is requested.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用原始人语气压缩 AI 回复,最高省 65% 输出量
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望 AI 回复更简短、更省 token
copy.tagline_en: Speak caveman to slash token output by up to 65%.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want terse AI responses and lower token usage.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 用极简“原始人”风格回复:去掉客套和废话,保留全部技术细节,代码与报错原文不变,输出 token 按原文称减少 65%。默认强度 full,每次回复都保持,直到你说“stop caveman”或“normal mode”才关闭。
howto.when: 当你说“caveman mode”“talk like caveman”等关键词,或要求“less tokens”等简略表达,或调用 /caveman 时触发;只要要求更省 token 也会自动触发。

say.text: 开启 caveman 模式,解释 React 为什么重渲染。
say.note: Claude 用极简风格回答,技术细节保留。

say.text: 用 caveman 模式回答,少说废话。
say.note: 默认是 full 强度,也可用 /caveman 调整档位。

say.text: 把这段报错用 caveman 风格总结一下。
say.note: 只留最短关键行,错误原文不变。

howto.what_en: After enabling, Claude talks in terse 'smart caveman' style: no filler, no pleasantries, technical substance, code, error text stay. Output tokens cut 65% (per skill). Stays on until 'stop caveman' or 'normal mode'.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says 'caveman mode', 'talk like caveman', etc., asks for 'less tokens' or similar brevity phrasing, or invokes /caveman; also auto-triggers when token efficiency is requested.

say_en.text: Turn on caveman mode and explain why React re-renders.
say_en.note: Claude answers in terse style, keeping technical substance.

say_en.text: Answer in caveman mode, less fluff.
say_en.note: Default is full intensity; use /caveman lite or ultra to adjust.

say_en.text: Summarize this error in caveman style.
say_en.note: Quotes shortest decisive line, keeps exact error text.
